subject: Orbit Analytics POC kickoff — sample payload checklist & scheduling
messages:
From: Marta Vazquez <marta.vazquez@orbitanalytics.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Khan <samir.khan@orbitanalytics.com>
Date: 2027-02-14T09:05:00-08:00
Subject: Orbit POC kickoff — quick sync + sample bundle

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team at Orbit is excited to move to a hands-on POC. We'd like to lock a kickoff working session next week where we can: run a short prompt review, confirm routing (multi-model + fallback), and execute a light load test (up to ~50 concurrent simulated users).

Action items from our side: we can share an anonymized sample set (~2k prompts, mix of short & long) and a link to an S3 bucket with payloads. Can you confirm the best way to ingest those samples (CSV vs ndjson), and any required redaction steps? Also please propose 2–3 kickoff windows.

Attaching: none yet — I can upload samples to the Drive link below.

Best,
Marta
Head of ML Ops
Orbit Analytics

--
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Marta Vazquez <marta.vazquez@orbitanalytics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-14T11:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Orbit POC kickoff — quick sync + sample bundle

Hi Marta — great to hear you want to move forward. We'd be happy to run the working session and the light load test. Quick answers up front:

- Preferred ingest: ndjson for prompt sets with metadata (one JSON object per line). CSV is fine for simple prompt-only lists but ndjson preserves context fields (conversation_id, user_type, expected_length).
- Redaction: remove direct PII (names, emails, phone numbers). For any structured PHI/PII use the attached POC_Sample_Redaction_Guide.pdf as a checklist.
- File transfer: Share an S3 pre-signed URL or place files in the Drive folder (link below) and grant read access to redwood-poc@redwood.com.

Proposed kickoff windows (all PT):
- Tue 2027-02-16: 10:00–12:00 (2h hands-on)
- Wed 2027-02-17: 13:00–15:00 (2h hands-on)
- Thu 2027-02-18: 09:00–11:00 (2h hands-on)

Karthik will lead prompt review and routing tests; Marissa will run the load plan and observe metrics. Please confirm preferred slot and whether Samir will share the sample bundle before the session.

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=POC123
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeFgPOC-ORBIT

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference

--
From: Marta Vazquez <marta.vazquez@orbitanalytics.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Khan <samir.khan@orbitanalytics.com>
Date: 2027-02-15T08:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Orbit POC kickoff — quick sync + sample bundle

Thanks Stephanie — Wed 2027-02-17 13:00–15:00 PT works best for our engineers. I'll upload an initial payload to S3 tonight (link below) and add a README with field descriptions. Expect ~2,000 records; about 15% have email-like identifiers that we'll scrub per your guide.

A couple of asks for the run:
- Can you validate routing for two model variants (r1: smaller quantized for low-latency, r2: full FP16 for quality) and configure an automatic fallback if r1's output confidence is below 0.6?
- For the load test, target patterns: 50 concurrent short prompts for 5 minutes, spike (200 qps) for 30s to simulate bursts.

S3 sample: s3://orbit-poc/samples/initial_payload_ndjson (I will send a pre-signed URL once upload completes).

I attached a quick sample of prompts in CSV that shows the expected fields.

Best,
Marta

> Hi Marta — great to hear you want to move forward. We'd be happy to run the working session and the light load test...

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marta Vazquez <marta.vazquez@orbitanalytics.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-15T12:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Orbit POC kickoff — quick sync + sample bundle

Thanks Marta — I see the plan and the load profile. A few clarifications from the engineering side:

1) Routing & fallback
- We will create two routes: orbit-r1 (quantized low-latency) and orbit-r2 (higher-quality). We'll run A/B tests during the session and enable confidence-based fallback (threshold 0.6) as you requested. If you have any sample labels or expected output format, include them in the README so we can instrument quality checks.

2) Ingest format
- Please prefer ndjson. If you must send CSV, include an id and full_text column. For conversation-based prompts, include convo_id and turn_index.

3) Load harness
- We'll use a local jmeter harness to simulate the concurrency profile you described. We'll publish a simple runbook (runbook_v1.md) into the Drive folder and attach a minimal set of synthetic replacement tokens for redaction tests.

Attachments: runbook_v1.md, prompt_samples.csv

Proposed agenda for Wed 2027-02-17 13:00–15:00 PT:
- 13:00–13:15: Introductions & goals (Stephanie)
- 13:15–13:40: Prompt review & redaction check (Karthik)
- 13:40–14:10: Routing configuration, fallback test (Karthik + Stephanie)
- 14:10–14:40: Load test & metrics review (Marissa)
- 14:40–15:00: Next steps and success criteria (all)

If that agenda looks good I'll add the runbook and test scripts to the Drive folder and send a shepherd checklist for the session.

-Karthik
Principal Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

--
From: Marta Vazquez <marta.vazquez@orbitanalytics.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Khan <samir.khan@orbitanalytics.com>
Date: 2027-02-16T14:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Orbit POC kickoff — quick sync + sample bundle

Thanks, all — confirming Wed 2027-02-17 13:00–15:00 PT. I've uploaded the initial ndjson bundle and README to S3 and created a pre-signed link (expires 2027-02-20): https://s3-presigned.example.com/orbit-poc-initial.ndjson

Notes:
- We scrubbed obvious PII per your redaction guide; I left a few synthetic placeholders so you can validate redaction detection.
- I've also moved one constraint: our security reviewer asked that any engine logs from the session be retained only for 7 days. Is that acceptable? If not, let us know the minimum retention you need for debugging.

Samir (cc) will be on the call for the routing portion. See you tomorrow.

Regards,
Marta
